_note_book: The Alpaca paper account's name: keys ALPACA_EVENTS_KEY_ID / ALPACA_EVENTS_SECRET_KEY, client order ids events-<YYYYMMDD>-<SYMBOL>-1, and the state directory must be named 'events'.
_note_sleeves: Team lead 2026-11-16: seven shadow books at $15,000 each. A sleeve's decision weights are fractions of its capital_usd here (the shadow file's own notional is ignored). enabled=false with shares still in the ledger FLATTENS that sleeve; to stop it without trading, halt the book.
_note_min_order_usd: DERIVED 2026-11-16, to confirm. cef_exdate_after holds every eligible fund of a 91-fund universe on its long side: about $7,500 / 85 = $88 a fund. At the earlier proposal of $100 none of those would ever be bought and the sleeve would sit short-only in the account. $25 lets them trade and still drops a one-share re-sizing in a $10 fund. Paper charges no commission.
_note_max_gross_x_equity: Team lead 2026-11-16. The book's gross after the plan, as a multiple of account equity. Above it every sleeve's targets are scaled by one factor at PLAN; SEND judges an adding set against the same multiple on the lower of planned and live equity (the core's stress rule).
_note_max_name_usd: DERIVED 2026-11-16, to confirm. IWM is the hedge of three sleeves: pead_small_long shorts 100% of its capital ($15,000) and each special-dividend sleeve up to 50% ($7,500), $30,000 together. $35,000 leaves room for price drift; any other name is far below it. Above it the whole plan is refused, naming the symbol.
_note_max_stale_sessions: PROPOSAL. A sleeve with no usable decision holds its shares for this many sessions in a row, then is flattened.
_note_max_orders: DERIVED 2026-11-16, to confirm. The first session builds every book at once: about 97 names in pead_small_long, 85 in the closed-end fund books, 45 in the unit books, a few in special dividends. Above this the plan is refused.
_note_execution: The paper exception of 2026-09-29 (CLAUDE.md order-path rule 3): market day orders before the close. No other mode is built.
